rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_DIR=`dirname $0`
SERVICE=nmtool_cm_agent
cmagentPath=$UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent
systemctl status ${SERVICE} &>/dev/null    
if [ $? -eq 0 ]
then
	echo "${SERVICE}is runing, please check and stop it before install"
	exit 0
fi

ROOT_DIR=`pwd`
data=`gcc -v 2>&1`
if [[ $data =~ "gcc version" ]]||[[ $data =~ "gcc 版本" ]]
then
  echo 安装了gcc
else 
  echo 没有安装gcc,自动安装gcc
  #rpm -Uvh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/tools/gcc/*.rpm --nodeps --force 
fi
#source ${UNM_ROOT}/server/tool/unmvars.sh
$UNM_ROOT/server/tool/Python27/python -m pip install --no-index --find-links=$UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/packages -r $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/requirements-linux.txt

#unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH
#chmod 777 cmagentstart.server
#chmod 777 nmtool_cm_agent.service

startType="0"
if [ ! -f $UNM_ROOT/unm2000install.ini ];
then
	echo not exit unm2000install.ini file
else
    startType=$(cat $UNM_ROOT/unm2000install.ini | grep startType | awk -F '=' '{print $2}')
fi
if [[ $startType -eq "1" ]]
then
        sudo chmod u+r $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent.service
		sudo cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/cmagentstart.server /etc/init.d/
		sudo cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent-user.service /usr/lib/systemd/system/nmtool_cm_agent.service
	
        sudo systemctl enable nmtool_cm_agent
        sudo systemctl daemon-reload
		if [ ! -d $cmagentPath/temp ];then
			mkdir $cmagentPath/temp
		fi
else
		chmod u+r $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent.service
		cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/cmagentstart.server /etc/init.d/
		cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent.service /usr/lib/systemd/system/nmtool_cm_agent.service
		systemctl enable $SERVICE
        systemctl daemon-reload
fi

rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

#!/bin/bash -x

# If a bundle file is present, call tox with the jenkins version of
# the test environment so it is used.  Otherwise, use the normal
# (non-bundle) test environment.  Also, run pbr freeze on the
# resulting environment at the end so that we have a record of exactly
# what packages we ended up testing.
#
# Usage: run-tox.sh VENV
#
# Where VENV is the name of the tox environment to run (specified in the
# project's tox.ini file).

venv=$1
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

if [[ -z "$venv" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $?"
    echo
    echo "VENV: The tox environment to run (eg 'python27')"
    exit 1
fi

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.132.3.7:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}

function freeze_venv {
    [ -e $bin_path/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

    echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
    echo "======================================================================"
    ${bin_path}/${freezecmd} freeze | sort -f
    echo "======================================================================"
}

function process_testr_artifacts {
    if [ ! -d ".testrepository" ] ; then
        return
    fi

    if [ -f ".testrepository/0.2" ] ; then

    elif [ -f ".testrepository/0" ] ; then

    fi

    $bin_path/subunit2html ./testrepository.subunit testr_results.html
    SUBUNIT_SIZE=$(du -k ./testrepository.subunit | awk '{print $1}')
    gzip -9 ./testrepository.subunit
    gzip -9 ./testr_results.html

    if [[ "$SUBUNIT_SIZE" -gt 50000 ]]; then
        echo
        echo "testrepository.subunit was > 50 MB of uncompressed data!!!"
        echo "Something is causing tests for this project to log significant amounts"
        echo "of data. This may be writers to python logging, stdout, or stderr."
        echo "Failing this test as a result"
        echo
        exit 1
    fi

    rancount=$($bin_path/testr last | sed -ne 's/Ran \([0-9]\+\).*tests in.*//p')
    if [ -z "$rancount" ] || [ "$rancount" -eq "0" ] ; then
        echo
        echo "Zero tests were run. At least one test should have been run."
        echo "Failing this test as a result"
        echo
        exit 1
    fi
}

function check_sudo_usage {
    sudo $script_path/jenkins-sudo-grep.sh post

        echo
        echo "This test has failed because it attempted to execute commands"
        echo "with sudo.  See above for the exact commands used."
        echo
        exit 1
    fi
}

function check_oom {
    $script_path/jenkins-oom-grep.sh post

export MINIO_ACCESS_USER=admin 
export MINIO_SECRT_KEY=password 
APPNAME=Minio
getpid(){
	pid=`ps -ef | grep minio | grep server| awk '{print $2}'`;
	if [ -n "$pid" ];
	then 
		return 1
	else
		return 0
	fi
}

getpid
#when pid is not empty. $?=1
if [ $? -eq 1 ]
then
   	echo "${APPNAME} is already running. pid:${pid}."
	echo "will killing thread(program_name:${APPNAME} pid:${pid})"
	kill -9 ${pid}
	echo "starting your program ${APPNAME}.waiting......"
	#cd /usr/local/src/iot-device-manage-cloud

rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

rsp_body:
#!/bin/sh

# Licensed to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) under one or more
# contributor license agreements.  See the NOTICE file distributed with

# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.

case $1 in
    producer)

    pid=`ps ax | grep -i 'org.apache.rocketmq.example.benchmark.Producer' |grep java | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1}'`
    if [ -z "$pid" ] ; then
            echo "No benchmark producer running."
            exit -1;
    fi

    echo "The benchmark producer(${pid}) is running..."

    kill ${pid}

    echo "Send shutdown request to benchmark producer(${pid}) OK"
    ;;
    consumer)

    pid=`ps ax | grep -i 'org.apache.rocketmq.example.benchmark.Consumer' |grep java | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1}'`
    if [ -z "$pid" ] ; then
            echo "No benchmark consumer running."
            exit -1;
    fi

    echo "The benchmark consumer(${pid}) is running..."

    kill ${pid}

    echo "Send shutdown request to benchmark consumer(${pid}) OK"
    ;;
    tproducer)

    pid=`ps ax | grep -i 'org.apache.rocketmq.example.benchmark.TransactionProducer' |grep java | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1}'`
    if [ -z "$pid" ] ; then
            echo "No benchmark transaction producer running."
            exit -1;
    fi

    echo "The benchmark transaction producer(${pid}) is running..."

    kill ${pid}

    echo "Send shutdown request to benchmark transaction producer(${pid}) OK"
    ;;
    bproducer)

    pid=`ps ax | grep -i 'org.apache.rocketmq.example.benchmark.BatchProducer' |grep java | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1}'`
    if [ -z "$pid" ] ; then
            echo "No benchmark batch producer running."
            exit -1;
    fi

    echo "The benchmark batch producer(${pid}) is running..."

    kill ${pid}

    echo "Send shutdown request to benchmark batch producer(${pid}) OK"
    ;;
    *)
    echo "Usage: shutdown producer | consumer | tproducer | bproducer"
esac

then
	systemctl status ${SERVICE} &>/dev/null
	if [ $? -eq 0 ]
		then
        echo "${SERVICE} is running"
	else
	   echo "start ${SERVICE}"
	   sudo systemctl start nmtool_cm_agent
	fi
else 
	pids=`ps -ef |grep $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent |grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}'`
	#port=`netstat -tunlp | grep 10081 | grep -v grep | awk '{print $7}'`
	if [ "$pids" != "" ] 
	then
		echo "${SERVICE} is running"
	else
		source /etc/profile
		systemctl start nmtool_cm_agent
	fi
fi

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
@echo off
setlocal ENABLEDELAYEDEXPANSION
:: param1---node.zip
set node_file_pre=%1
:: ---------------------------prepare node path--------------------------------------
set node_parent=D:
op\necho node_parent=%node_parent%
set node_path=%node_parent%%node_file_pre%\necho "node_path:"%node_path%
set path=%node_path%;C:\Program Files\WinRAR;%path%
echo "path:"%path%
set origin_folder=%~dp0
echo %origin_folder%
cd ..
set parent_folder=%cd%
echo parent_folder%parent_folder%
set tool_folder=%parent_folder%\dev_tools
echo tool_folder%tool_folder%
if not exist %node_path% (
	echo remove dir %node_path%
	rd /s /q %node_path%
	call WinRAR.exe X %tool_folder%\%node_file_pre%.zip %node_parent%
)

cd %origin_folder%

::---------------------------check ng-----------------------------------
:ng
call where ng
	if !errorlevel!==0 (
		:ngOK
		echo "-----ng is already installed-----"
		call ng version
	) else (
		:: config npm registry
		echo "-----set npm registry http://prdrepo.fiberhome.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm -----"
		call npm config set registry http://prdrepo.fiberhome.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm

		cd %node_path%

	::---------------------------install ng-----------------------------------
		echo "-----install @angular/cli@8.1.0... -----"
		call npm install @angular/cli@8.1.0
		if !errorlevel!==0 (
			call ng version
		) else (
			@echo "-----global install ng cli failed! -----"
			goto end
		)
	)
::--- add --max_old_space_size=4096 to ng.cmd
call xcopy %tool_folder%
g.cmd %node_path% /H /K /R /Y

::---------------------------check waf-----------------------------------
:waf
call where waf
	if !errorlevel!==0 (
		:wafOK
		echo "-----waf is already installed-----"
		call waf --version
	) else (
	::---------------------------install waf-----------------------------------
		:: set node-sass binary path just for this bat
		echo parent_folder=%parent_folder%
		set SASS_BINARY_PATH=%tool_folder%\win32-x64-64_binding.node
		echo "SASS_BINARY_PATH:" !SASS_BINARY_PATH!
		:: config npm registry
		echo "-----set npm registry http://prdrepo.fiberhome.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm -----"
		call npm config set registry http://prdrepo.fiberhome.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm

		cd %node_path%

		echo "-----install waf... -----"
		call npm install @waf_cli/cli

		if !errorlevel!==0 (
			call waf --version
		) else (
			echo "-----install waf cli failed! -----"
			goto end
		)
	)

:: ---------------------------check npm 3.10.10--------------------------------------
for /F %%i in ('npm -v')do set npm_version=%%i
echo npm_version=!npm_version!
if !npm_version!==3.10.10 (
	call npm -v
) else (
    echo "-----npm version is not avalable!-----"
	echo "-----replace npm@!npm_version! with npm@3.10.10 -----"
	if exist %node_path%
ode_modules
pm@3.10.10.zip del %node_path%
ode_modules
pm@3.10.10.zip
	xcopy %tool_folder%
pm@3.10.10.zip	 %node_path%
ode_modules\n	rd %node_path%
ode_modules
pm /S /Q
	call WinRAR.exe X %node_path%
ode_modules
pm@3.10.10.zip %node_path%
ode_modules
	if !errorlevel!==0 (
		echo "-----npm@3.10.10 is already installed! current version:-----"
		call npm -v
	) else (
		echo "-----install npm@3.10.10 failed! -----"
		goto end
	)
)

cd %origin_folder%
call build-2.bat %node_file_pre%
:end
echo "-----end pre-build.bat-----"

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

service_name=UnmI2Web
current_path=$(cd `dirname $0`; pwd)
parent_path=$(cd `dirname $0`; cd ..; pwd)

echo current_path=$current_path
echo parent_path=$parent_path
chmod -R 777 $current_path

current_service=$current_path/UnmI2Web-back.service
dest_current_service=$current_path/UnmI2Web.service

if [ -e $dest_current_service ];
then
  rm -f $dest_current_service
fi
cp $current_service $dest_current_service

sed -i -e 's|\${home_path}|'"$current_path"'|g' $dest_current_service


# cp start_unm_web.server /etc/init.d/
cp $current_path/UnmI2Web.service /usr/lib/systemd/system
systemctl disable $service_name

#sh startI2Check.sh

#systemctl start $service_name

current_health_service=$current_path/I2WebCheck/UnmI2WebHealthCheck-back.service
dest_current_health_service=$current_path/I2WebCheck/UnmI2WebHealthCheck.service

if [ -e $dest_current_health_service ];
then
  rm -f $dest_current_health_service
fi
cp $current_health_service $dest_current_health_service

sed -i -e 's|\${home_path}|'"$current_path"'|g' $dest_current_health_service


cp $current_path/I2WebCheck/UnmI2WebHealthCheck.service /usr/lib/systemd/system

systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable UnmI2WebHealthCheck.service
systemctl start UnmI2WebHealthCheck.service

rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

cd `dirname $0`
echo $(pwd)
cd ..
chmod -R 777 *
export auth_root=$(pwd)
echo $auth_root
echo $UNM_ROOT

source $auth_root/bin/get_properties.sh
mysqlfilepath=$auth_root/config/application-mysql.yml
postgresfilepath=$auth_root/config/application-postgres.yml

ipdefault="127.0.0.1"
if [ -z $DBIP ];then
	  echo "dbip is empty"
	else
    sed -i "s#$ipdefault#$DBIP#g" $mysqlfilepath
    sed -i "s#$ipdefault#$DBIP#g" $postgresfilepath
fi

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
@echo off

set server_ip=%1
set server_user=%2
set server_pwd=%3
set install_path=%4
set cusaplatform_user_dir=%5
set cusaplatform_root_path=%~d0
set cusaagent_folder=CusaDeployAgent
echo "cusaplatform_root_path is: " %cusaplatform_root_path%
echo "cusaplatform_user_dir is: " %cusaplatform_user_dir%

cd /d %~dp0
:: D:\software\CusaAllInOne\Cusaplatform	hirdparty
set local_folder=%cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\%cusaagent_folder%_win
:: set remote_folder=\10.170.90.218\D$\CusaDeployAgent
set remote_folder=\%server_ip%\%install_path%$\%cusaagent_folder%
echo "local_folder path: " %local_folder%
echo "remote_folder path: " %remote_folder%
:: D:\software\CusaAllInOne\Cusaplatform\log
set log_file_path=%cusaplatform_user_dir%\log
echo %cd%
echo "-----set args finished!-----"

:: if exist %cd%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win.log del %cd%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win.log /f /s /q /a
if exist %log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log del /F /S /Q %log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log

if not exist %local_folder% (
    echo "error: %local_folder% not exist"
    echo "%local_folder% not exist">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)

net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user%
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo " error: net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user% is fail"
    echo "net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user% is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
@echo "-----connect successed!-----"

if exist %remote_folder% (
    echo "%remote_folder% is exist, call stop.bat and delete %remote_folder%"
    %cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\WMIC.exe /node:%server_ip% /user:%server_user% /password:%server_pwd% process call create "cmd /c %install_path%:\%cusaagent_folder%\service\stop.bat"
    ping %server_ip% -n 30 >nul
    rd /S /Q %remote_folder%
)


xcopy %local_folder% %remote_folder% /D /E /Y /H /K /R /I
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% is fail"
    echo "xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
if not exist %remote_folder% (
    echo "error: %remote_folder% is not exist"
    echo "%remote_folder% is not exist">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
echo "-----xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% finished!-----"


if exist %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip% (
    rd /S /Q %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%
) else (
    md %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%
)
CALL %local_folder%\service\create-cusaagentxml.bat %server_ip% %install_path%:\%cusaagent_folder%
if not exist %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml (
    echo "error: create %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml is fail"
    echo "create %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)

if exist %remote_folder%\service\cusa-agent.xml del /S /Q %remote_folder%\service\cusa-agent.xml /f /s /q /a

copy %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml \%server_ip%\%4$\%cusaagent_folder%\service\ /y
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml to \%server_ip%\%4$\CusaDeployAgent\service\ is fail"
    echo "%local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml to \%server_ip%\%4$\CusaDeployAgent\service\ is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
rd /S /Q %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%

net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ /delete
echo "-----delete connect successed!-----"

%cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\WMIC.exe /node:%server_ip% /user:%server_user% /password:%server_pwd% process call create "cmd /c D:\CusaDeployAgent\service\start.bat"
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    set error_msg="call start.bat is fail"
    echo %error_msg%
    echo %error_msg%>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
@echo "-----install cusaagent successed!
exit /b 0

:ERROREXIT
exit /b 1

#!/bin/bash -x

# Copyright 2013 OpenStack Foundation

# a copy of the License at

# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT
# WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied. See the
# License for the specific language governing permissions and limitations
# under the License.

venv=${1:-pep8}
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.132.3.7:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}
export_upper_constratints_file

virtualenv sdist_check && sdist_check/bin/pip install pbr && sdist_check/bin/python setup.py sdist
sdistrc=$?
rm -rf sdist_check

tox -v -e$venv
rc=$?

[ -e .tox/$venv/bin/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
echo "======================================================================"
.tox/${venv}/bin/${freezecmd} freeze
echo "======================================================================"

if [ ! $sdistrc ] ; then
    echo "******************************************************************"
    echo "Project cannot create sdist tarball!!!"
    echo "To reproduce this locally, run: 'python setup.py sdist'"
    echo "******************************************************************"
    exit $sdistrc
fi

exit $rc

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

#! /bin/sh
echo "设置系统环境变量"

sed -ie '/#dbbegin/,/#dbendd/d' -ie /etc/profile

echo "#dbbegin" >>/etc/profile
echo "export UNM_ROOT=/opt/unm2000" >>/etc/profile

echo "export PYTHONHOME=/opt/unm2000/server/tool/Python27" >>/etc/profile

echo "export PAS_ROOT=/opt/unm2000" >>/etc/profile
echo "export PATH=${PYTHONHOME}:${PATH}" >>/etc/profile
echo "#dbendd" >>/etc/profile
cat /etc/profile
source /etc/profile

echo "系统环境变量设置完成"

mv /opt/UNM2000 /opt/unm2000

chmod -R 755 /opt/unm2000

echo "PYTHONHOME=$PYTHONHOME"
echo "UNM_ROOT=$UNM_ROOT"
echo "PAS_ROOT=$PAS_ROOT"
echo "PATH=$PATH"

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

currentdir=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")"; pwd)

localip=`ip a|grep inet|grep -v 127.0.0.1|grep -v inet6|awk '{print $2}'|awk -F'/' '{print $1}'`
echo "服务器IP："$localip
port=`grep port config.json |grep "|awk -F':' '{print $2}'|grep "|awk -F'"' '{print $2}'`
echo "端口："$port

source /etc/profile
nohup node $currentdir/vendors/server/app.js >/dev/null 2>&1 &

yapinum=`ps -ef|grep vendors/server/app.js|grep -v grep|awk '{print $2}'|wc -l`
while [[ 1 != $yapinum ]]; do
	yapinum=`ps -ef|grep vendors/server/app.js|grep -v grep|awk '{print $2}'|wc -l`
	echo "等待yapi服务启动"
done
sleep 3
java -jar ../sliceTool/SliceTool.jar ice2yapi $localip:$port

rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_DIR=`dirname $0`
SERVICE=nmtool_cm_agent
cmagentPath=$UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent
systemctl status ${SERVICE} &>/dev/null    
if [ $? -eq 0 ]
then
	echo "${SERVICE}is runing, please check and stop it before install"
	systemctl stop ${SERVICE}
fi

ROOT_DIR=`pwd`
data=`gcc -v 2>&1`
if [[ $data =~ "gcc version" ]]||[[ $data =~ "gcc 版本" ]]
then
  echo 安装了gcc
else 
  echo 没有安装gcc,自动安装gcc
  #rpm -Uvh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/tools/gcc/*.rpm --nodeps --force 
fi
#source ${UNM_ROOT}/server/tool/unmvars.sh
$UNM_ROOT/server/tool/Python27/python -m pip install --no-index --find-links=$UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/packages -r $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/requirements-linux.txt

#unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH
#chmod 777 cmagentstart.server
#chmod 777 nmtool_cm_agent.service

startType="0"
if [ ! -f $UNM_ROOT/unm2000install.ini ];
then
	echo not exit unm2000install.ini file
else
    startType=$(cat $UNM_ROOT/unm2000install.ini | grep startType | awk -F '=' '{print $2}')
fi
if [[ $startType -eq "1" ]]
then
        sudo chmod u+r $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent.service
		sudo cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/cmagentstart.server /etc/init.d/
		sudo cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent-user.service /usr/lib/systemd/system/nmtool_cm_agent.service
	
        sudo systemctl enable nmtool_cm_agent
        sudo systemctl daemon-reload
		if [ ! -d $cmagentPath/temp ];then
			mkdir $cmagentPath/temp
		fi
else
		chmod u+r $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent.service
		cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/cmagentstart.server /etc/init.d/
		cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent.service /usr/lib/systemd/system/nmtool_cm_agent.service
		systemctl enable $SERVICE
        systemctl daemon-reload
fi

#!/bin/bash
# Copyright 2017 gRPC authors.
#
# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You may obtain a copy of the License at

# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.

set -ex

# cd "$(dirname "$0")/../../.."
cd $2

# Install openssl (to use instead of boringssl)
# apt-get update && apt-get install -y libssl-dev
export INSTALL_DIR=$3/install
export OPENSSL_DIR=$6

# 1.46.5 version cannot be compiled by gcc-4.8. by lizhuo
export CC=$2/gcc-4.9.4/bin/gcc
export CXX=$2/gcc-4.9.4/bin/g++
export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -fPIC -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections"
export CXXFLAGS="$CFLAGS $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$2/gcc-4.9.4/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH

# Use externally provided env to determine build parallelism, otherwise use default.
# GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS=${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS:-4}

# Install absl
rm -rf "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
#cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
#make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install c-ares
rm -rf "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCARES_STATIC=ON -DCARES_SHARED=OFF ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install protobuf
rm -rf "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -Dprotobuf_BUILD_TESTS=OFF ..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -Dprotobuf_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install re2
rm -rf "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install zlib
rm -rf "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Just before installing gRPC, wipe out contents of all the submodules to simulate
# a standalone build from an archive
# shellcheck disable=SC2016
# git submodule foreach 'cd $toplevel; rm -rf $name'

# Install gRPC
rm -rf "cmake/build"
mkdir -p "cmake/build"
pushd "cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" \n  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 \n  -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR \n  -DOPENSSL_ROOT_DIR=$OPENSSL_DIR \n  -DZLIB_ROOT=%INSTALL_DIR% \n  -DgRPC_INSTALL=ON \n  -DgRPC_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \n  -DgRPC_ABSL_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_CARES_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_PROTOBUF_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_RE2_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_SSL_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_ZLIB_PROVIDER=package \n  ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
#make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# # Build helloworld example using Makefile and pkg-config
# pushd examples/cpp/helloworld
# export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/local/grpc/lib/pkgconfig
# export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/grpc/bin
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}"
# popd

# # Build route_guide example using Makefile and pkg-config
# pushd examples/cpp/route_guide
# export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/local/grpc/lib/pkgconfig
# export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/grpc/bin
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}"
# popd

# The script is jenkins job to compile rpm packages for fitos.
# Jenkins Parameters:
# $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH: the branch for repository manifest
# $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE: incremental compile or not
# $PKG_LIST: package targets list to compile, empty to compile all
# $FH_DATE: compile time formated yyyyMMdd_HHmm
# Such as: http://10.132.3.10:8080/view/FitOS-CD/job/fitos-compile-rpm/
# The script must be executed at compile machine, such as 10.127.2.26

source /usr/local/bin/finishSetup.sh
openEuler_RPM_code=()

openEuler_RPM_spec=()

tis_patch_ver=`date +"%y%m%d"`
_tis_dist=.fitos.v5r2m3


if [ ! $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE ]; then
  INCREMENTAL_COMPILE=false
fi

if [[ $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE == false ]]; then
  # clean dir
  sudo rm -rf $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
  sudo rm -rf $MY_WORKSPACE
  mkdir -p $MY_REPO
  mkdir -p $MY_WORKSPACE

  # init repo manifest
  cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
  repo init -u ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/manifest.git -b $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH -m default.xml --repo-url=ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/git-repo.git --no-repo-verify
fi

cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
repo sync

#Insert CPU_ARCH to all spec files
if [ ! $CPU_ARCH ];then
	CPU_ARCH=x86_64
fi
find ./ -name '*.spec' | xargs sed -i '1 i\%define arch '"$CPU_ARCH"''

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        sed -i 's/%{?_tis_dist}/'"$_tis_dist"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
        sed -i 's/%{tis_patch_ver}/'"$tis_patch_ver"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

###Clean up rpmbuild/
##ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SRPMS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILD/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILDROOT/*
##exit
##eeooff
##
###Copy openEuler source code and spec files to 10.127.2.239
##cd $MY_REPO/stx/git
##for i in ${openEuler_RPM_code[@]}
##    do
##        tar -zcf $i.tar.gz $i
##        scp $i.tar.gz fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/
##        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/git/$i.tar.gz
##    done
##
##for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
##    do
##        scp $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
##        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
##    done

#build Centos RPMs
cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
build-pkgs $PKG_LIST
rm -rf ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.src.rpm

###build openEuler RPMs
##ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
##set -o errexit
##cd /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
##rpmbuild -ba *
##set +o errexit
##exit
##eeooff
##if [[ $? -ne 0 ]];then
##    exit 1
##fi
##
### Copy RPMs to 10.132.3.4
##if [ ! $FH_DATE ]; then
##  FH_DATE=`date +%Y%m%d_%H%M`
##fi

if [ $CPU_ARCH == x86_64 ];then
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ## scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
else
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  sleep 5
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ## scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
fi

rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash -xe
# The script is jenkins job to compile rpm packages for fitos.
# Jenkins Parameters:
# $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH: the branch for repository manifest
# $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE: incremental compile or not
# $PKG_LIST: package targets list to compile, empty to compile all
# $FH_DATE: compile time formated yyyyMMdd_HHmm
# Such as: http://10.132.3.10:8080/view/FitOS-CD/job/fitos-compile-rpm/
# The script must be executed at compile machine, such as 10.127.2.26

source /usr/local/bin/finishSetup.sh
openEuler_RPM_code=('python3_oslo_config' \n'python-cipherclient' \n'python-licenseclient' \n'python-monitorclient' \n'python-serviceclient' \n'update' \n'python3_oslo_messaging')

openEuler_RPM_spec=('recipes-base/python-oslo-config/euler/python3-oslo-config.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/python-cipherclient/euler/cipherclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/licenseclient/euler/licenseclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/python-monitorclient/euler/monitorclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/serviceclient/euler/serviceclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/cgcs-patch/euler/cgcs-patch.spec' \n'recipes-base/python-oslo-messaging/euler/python3-oslo-messaging.spec')

tis_patch_ver=`date +"%y%m%d"`
_tis_dist=.fitos.v5r2m3


if [ ! $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE ]; then
  INCREMENTAL_COMPILE=false
fi

if [[ $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE == false ]]; then
  # clean dir
  sudo rm -rf $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
  sudo rm -rf $MY_WORKSPACE
  mkdir -p $MY_REPO
  mkdir -p $MY_WORKSPACE

  # init repo manifest
  cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
  repo init -u ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/manifest.git -b $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH -m default.xml --repo-url=ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/git-repo.git --no-repo-verify
fi

cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
repo sync

#Insert CPU_ARCH to all spec files
if [ ! $CPU_ARCH ];then
	CPU_ARCH=x86_64
fi
find ./ -name '*.spec' | xargs sed -i '1 i\%define arch '"$CPU_ARCH"''

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        sed -i 's/%{?_tis_dist}/'"$_tis_dist"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
        sed -i 's/%{tis_patch_ver}/'"$tis_patch_ver"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

#Clean up rpmbuild/
ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SRPMS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILD/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILDROOT/*
exit
eeooff

#Copy openEuler source code and spec files to 10.127.2.239
cd $MY_REPO/stx/git
for i in ${openEuler_RPM_code[@]}
    do
        tar -zcf $i.tar.gz $i
        scp $i.tar.gz fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/
        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/git/$i.tar.gz
    done

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        scp $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

#build Centos RPMs
cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
build-pkgs $PKG_LIST
rm -rf ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.src.rpm

#build openEuler RPMs
ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
set -o errexit
cd /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
rpmbuild -ba *
set +o errexit
exit
eeooff
if [[ $? -ne 0 ]];then
    exit 1
fi

# Copy RPMs to 10.132.3.4
if [ ! $FH_DATE ]; then
  FH_DATE=`date +%Y%m%d_%H%M`
fi

if [ $CPU_ARCH == x86_64 ];then
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
else
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  sleep 5
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
fi

goto end

:notinstalled
echo not exist %SERVER_NAME% do nothing
goto end

:end

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
@ECHO OFF
PUSHD .

SET SCRIPT_DIR=%~dp0
set JAVA_CMD=%UNM_ROOT%\platform\jre in\java
set JAVAW_CMD=%UNM_ROOT%\platform\jre in\javaw

CD "%SCRIPT_DIR%\.."
FOR /F %%I IN ('CD') DO SET ROOT_DIR=%%I

FOR /F %%I IN ('TYPE "%ROOT_DIR% in\jarfile"') DO SET PACKAGE_NAME=%%I
set MAIN_CLASS=com.fiberhome.ai.alarm.cusa.StartUp
echo %MAIN_CLASS%
TITLE %PACKAGE_NAME%
if "%1" neq "" (
  start /b %JAVAW_CMD% -Xmx4096m -DExtYmlUrl="%1" -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%"
) else (
  start /b %JAVAW_CMD% -Xmx4096m -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%"
)
exit
::CALL java -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%"

POPD

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
source /etc/profile
cd /etc/init.d

chmod 777 /etc/init.d/unmstop.server
chmod 777 /etc/init.d/unmtoolstop.server
# chmod 777 /etc/init.d/unmtomcat.server
chmod 777 $UNM_ROOT/script/killAllProcess.sh

if [ -d "/usr/local/nginx" ];then
rm -r /user/local/nginx
fi

chkconfig --del unmstart.server

chkconfig --del unmtoolstart.server

chkconfig --del passtart.server

#Í£Ö¹·þÎñ

/etc/init.d/unmstop.server
/etc/init.d/unmtoolstop.server
# /etc/init.d/unmtomcat.server stop
/etc/init.d/unmactivemq.server stop
/etc/init.d/unmtao.server stop


$UNM_ROOT/script/killAllProcess.sh

#È¡Ïû¿ª»ú×ÔÆô¶¯
chkconfig -d unmactivemq.server
chkconfig -d unmtao.server
result=$(cat /etc/SuSE-release | grep "VERSION = 12" )
if [[ "$result" != "" ]] ;then
     version="12"
else
     version="11"
fi
if [[ "$version" = "12" ]] ;then
    systemctl disable unm2000.service
    systemctl disable unmtool.service 
    # systemctl disable tomcat.service
else
    chkconfig -del unmstart.server
    chkconfig -del unmtoolstart.server
    # chkconfig -del tomcat.service
fi

#cusaÐ¶ÔØ±ß³µ
revisionfile=$UNM_ROOT/server/etc/revision.txt
grep "iscusa=true" $revisionfile>>/dev/nul
if [ $? -eq 0 ];then
	sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/sidecar/bin/uninstall_sidecar_service.sh
fi

# Ð¶ÔØ¹ÜÀí¹¤¾ß
sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/scripts/uninstall_nmtool.sh

#Ð¶ÔØnginx
sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nginx/script_linux/uninstall_service.sh

if [[ $deploymode -eq 1 || $deploymode -eq 2 ]];then
chmod 777 $UNM_ROOT/jetty/uninstalljetty.sh
#Ð¶ÔØjetty
sh $UNM_ROOT/jetty/uninstalljetty.sh
fi

cd $UNM_ROOT/script
# rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtomcat.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unm.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmstart.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmstop.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtool.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtoolstart.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtoolstop.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmactivemq.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtao.server

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

currentdir=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")"; pwd)

localip=`ip a|grep inet|grep -v 127.0.0.1|grep -v inet6|awk '{print $2}'|awk -F'/' '{print $1}'`
echo "服务器IP："$localip
port=`grep port config.json |grep "|awk -F':' '{print $2}'|grep "|awk -F'"' '{print $2}'`
echo "端口："$port

source /etc/profile
nohup node $currentdir/vendors/server/app.js >/dev/null 2>&1 &

yapinum=`ps -ef|grep vendors/server/app.js|grep -v grep|awk '{print $2}'|wc -l`
while [[ 1 != $yapinum ]]; do
	yapinum=`ps -ef|grep vendors/server/app.js|grep -v grep|awk '{print $2}'|wc -l`
	echo "等待yapi服务启动"
done
sleep 3
java -jar ../sliceTool/SliceTool.jar ice2yapi $localip:$port

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

rsp_body:
@echo off
Setlocal Enabledelayedexpansion

set localPath=%~dp0
call %localPath%\getpathdir.bat

if "%1"=="NOPAUSE" goto INSTALL

set /p CONFIRM=Are you sure to create all database? Click y to continue.
if not "%CONFIRM%"=="y" goto :EOF

set Str=0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ
set /a len=6
for /l %%i in (1,1,8888) do (if "!Str:~0,%%i!"=="!Str!" set StrSum=%%i&goto :result)
:result
set /a Num+=1,StrNum=%Random%%%%StrSum%
set result=%result%!str:~%StrNum%,1!
if %Num% lss %len% goto :result
echo %result%
set /p CONFIRM_AGAIN=Please enter same random string to comfirm createdatabase:
if not "%CONFIRM_AGAIN%"=="%result%" goto :EOF

:INSTALL

call "%~dp0log_for_kill_process.bat" caller "%~0"

call %u2KInstalPath%\server	ool\createdatabase.bat NOPAUSE

echo "Finished!"
if not "%1"=="NOPAUSE" pause

rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_DIR="$( cd -- "$( dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" )" &> /dev/null && pwd )"


cd $SCRIPT_DIR

NMTOOLS_DIR=$SCRIPT_DIR/..
AGNET_DIR=$NMTOOLS_DIR/unm_cm_agent
SERVICE_DIR=$NMTOOLS_DIR/unm_cm_service
NGINX_DIR=$SERVICE_DIR/thirdparty/nginx
chmod 777 $NMTOOLS_DIR/scripts/chmod_nmtool.sh
sh $NMTOOLS_DIR/scripts/chmod_nmtool.sh

cd $NMTOOLS_DIR
if [ ! -f $NMTOOLS_DIR/unm2000install.ini ];
then 
	echo $NMTOOLS_DIR/unm2000install.ini exist
else 
	echo $NMTOOLS_DIR/unm2000install.ini not exist
fi
cp -R $NMTOOLS_DIR/arm/python $AGNET_DIR
cp -R $NMTOOLS_DIR/arm/nginx $SERVICE_DIR/thirdparty


#注册cmagent服务
cd $AGNET_DIR
sh set_nmtool_var.sh
cd $AGNET_DIR/bin
sh install_nmtool_agent.sh

#注册cmservice服务
cd $SERVICE_DIR/bin
#chmod -R 777 install_nmtool_service.sh
sh install_nmtool_service.sh

#nginx
cd $NGINX_DIR/bin
#chmod -R 777 install_nmtool_webservice.sh
sh install_nmtool_webservice.sh

#开机自启
systemctl daemon-reload

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

# filter out unm2000 so library
# export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${LD_LIBRARY_PATH//\/opt\/unm2000\/[^:]*:/}

current_path=$(dirname $(readlink -f $"0"))
echo current_path=$current_path
unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH


CA="${current_path}/ca"
TLS="${current_path}/tls"

rm -rf "${TLS}"
mkdir -p "${TLS}"

#NR==2 use the second line
IP=`awk -F '=' 'NR==2{print $2}' ${current_path}/conf/product.conf`
echo ip=$IP

cat >  "${TLS}/openssl.cnf" << EOF
[ req ]
prompt                  = no
utf8                    = yes
string_mask             = utf8only

attributes              = req_attributes
req_extensions          = v3_req 
distinguished_name      = req_distinguished_name


[ req_distinguished_name ]
C                       = CN
ST                      = Hubei
L                       = Wuhan
O                       = Fiberhome
OU                      = FiberhomeWeb
CN                      = nmtool

[ req_attributes ]
challengePassword       = A challenge password

[ v3_req ]
basicConstraints        = CA:FALSE
keyUsage                = digitalSignature, keyEncipherment
extendedKeyUsage        = serverAuth
subjectAltName          = @alt_names

[ alt_names ]
IP = $IP
EOF


openssl genpkey \n        -algorithm RSA \n        -out "${TLS}/server.key" \n        -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048

openssl req -new \n        -key "${TLS}/server.key" \n        -out "${TLS}/server.csr" \n        -config "${TLS}/openssl.cnf" \n        -extensions v3_req

# openssl x509 \n#         -req \n#         -in "${TLS}/server.csr" \n#         -extfile "${TLS}/openssl.cnf" \n#         -extensions v3_req \n#         -CA "${CA}/ca.crt" \n#         -CAkey "${CA}/ca.key" \n#         -CAcreateserial \n#         -out "${TLS}/server.crt" \n#         -days 3650 \n#         -sha256

openssl ca -batch \n    -config "${CA}/openssl.cnf" \n    -keyfile "${CA}/ca.key" \n    -cert "${CA}/ca.crt" \n    -in "${TLS}/server.csr" \n    -out "${TLS}/server.crt" \n    -extfile "${TLS}/openssl.cnf" \n    -extensions v3_req \n    -create_serial \n    -startdate 20180101020000Z \n    -days 3650 

> ${CA}/index.txt

cp ${TLS}/server.key ${current_path}/conf/server_nopwd.key
cp ${TLS}/server.crt ${current_path}/conf/server.crt

# openssl x509 -in "${TLS}/server.crt"  -noout -text

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_DIR=$(dirname $(readlink -f "$0"))
temp_dir=$1

SOURCE_DIR=unm_cm_service
TARGET_PATH=$SCRIPT_DIR/../$SOURCE_DIR/unm_cm_service_java/unm-cm-distribution/target
#解压之后的位置
THIRDPARTY_PATH=$TARGET_PATH/unm_cm_service/thirdparty
NGINX_NMTOOL_PATH=$THIRDPARTY_PATH/nginx/html/nmtool
TEMP_DIR_PATH=$SCRIPT_DIR/$temp_dir
WEB_DIR=$SCRIPT_DIR/../dist/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0


#解压压缩包
unzip -q -o $TARGET_PATH/unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.zip -d $TARGET_PATH
rm -rf $TARGET_PATH/unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.zip

#制作windows压缩包 unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.zip

#javaservice
unzip -q -o $TEMP_DIR_PATH/javaservice.zip -d $THIRDPARTY_PATH
#jdk1.8.0_171
unzip -q -o $TEMP_DIR_PATH/jdk1.8.0_171.zip -d $THIRDPARTY_PATH
#nginx
unzip -q -o $TEMP_DIR_PATH/nginx.zip -d $THIRDPARTY_PATH
#前端代码
if [ ! -f $WEB_DIR/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip ];
then
	echo not exit nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip
else
    echo unzip nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip
	unzip -q -o $WEB_DIR/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip -d $NGINX_NMTOOL_PATH
fi


cd  $TARGET_PATH
zip -r -q $TARGET_PATH/unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.zip unm_cm_agent/ unm_cm_service/

#制作linux压缩包
rm -rf $THIRDPARTY_PATH/*

#java
cp $TEMP_DIR_PATH/openjdk-8u41.tar.gz $THIRDPARTY_PATH

#nginx
tar -xf $TEMP_DIR_PATH/nginx.tar -C $THIRDPARTY_PATH

if [ ! -f $WEB_DIR/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip ];
then
	echo not exit nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip
else
    echo unzip nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip
	unzip -q -o $WEB_DIR/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip -d $NGINX_NMTOOL_PATH
fi
zip -r -q $TARGET_PATH/unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT-linux.zip unm_cm_agent/ unm_cm_service/

#删除相关文件
rm -rf $TARGET_PATH/unm_cm_agent/
rm -rf $TARGET_PATH/unm_cm_service/

venv=${1:-pep8}
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.127.6.15/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.127.6.15/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.127.6.15:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}
export_upper_constratints_file

virtualenv sdist_check && sdist_check/bin/pip install pbr && sdist_check/bin/python setup.py sdist
sdistrc=$?
rm -rf sdist_check

tox -v -e$venv
rc=$?

[ -e .tox/$venv/bin/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
echo "======================================================================"
.tox/${venv}/bin/${freezecmd} freeze
echo "======================================================================"

if [ ! $sdistrc ] ; then
    echo "******************************************************************"
    echo "Project cannot create sdist tarball!!!"
    echo "To reproduce this locally, run: 'python setup.py sdist'"
    echo "******************************************************************"
    exit $sdistrc
fi

exit $rc

# Android kernel
## Compilation
The Android kernel source code is located in the `BST-C1200-LINUX-SDK-Vx.x.x.x-Release/opensource_code` directory as `kernel_android_xxxxxxxxx.tar.gz`. Refer to the [SDK installation](../../quickstart_en/sdk_userguide/sdk-install.md) section for instructions on installing container image dependencies. After setting up the FDK, DDK, and SDK container development environment, copy the source code archive into the container and execute the following commands to compile:

```shell
source /opt/bstos/linux-25/environment-setup-aarch64-bst-linux
./make_c1200_android.sh
```

The generated image, dtb, and defconfig files are located at:

```shell
build/arch/arm64/boot/Image
build/arch/arm64/boot/dts/bst/bstc1200-ivi.dtb
arch/arm64/configs/bstc1200_ivi_defconfig
```

**Note: The image generated here is only the Android kernel image. To generate a complete IVI system image, you need to download the Android code from the developer website and copy the three generated files to the corresponding locations in the Android code project for image compilation.**

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

#current_path=$(dirname $(readlink -f $"0"))
#thirdparty_path=$(dirname $(dirname $current_path))/thirdparty
#定时任务是通过cron.service文件执行的，当前目录变更为根目录了，所以这里采取在安装nginx的时候记录nginx的路径
nginx_home=$(cat /usr/nginx_home)
days=7
LOGS_PATH=$nginx_home/logs
 
NEWLOGS_PATH=$LOGS_PATH/history

if [ ! -d "$NEWLOGS_PATH" ];then
	mkdir $NEWLOGS_PATH
fi
 
YESTERDAY=$(date -d "yesterday" +%Y%m%d)
 

mv ${LOGS_PATH}/access.log ${NEWLOGS_PATH}/access_${YESTERDAY}.log
 
/bin/kill -SIGUSR1 $(cat $nginx_home/nginx.pid)

find $NEWLOGS_PATH/ -mtime +$days -delete

rsp_body:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# This script prints the release version for emqx

# ensure dir
cd -P -- "$(dirname -- "$0")"

if [ -f EMQX_ENTERPRISE ]; then
    EDITION='enterprise'
else
    EDITION='opensource'
fi

## emqx_release.hrl is the single source of truth for release version
RELEASE="$(grep -E "define.+EMQX_RELEASE.+${EDITION}" include/emqx_release.hrl | cut -d '"' -f2)"

git_exact_vsn() {
    local tag
    tag="$(git describe --tags --match "[e|v]*" --exact 2>/dev/null)"
    echo "${tag#[e|v]}"
}

GIT_EXACT_VSN="$(git_exact_vsn)"
if [ "$GIT_EXACT_VSN" != '' ]; then
    if [ "$GIT_EXACT_VSN" != "$RELEASE" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: Tagged $GIT_EXACT_VSN, but $RELEASE in include/emqx_release.hrl" 1>&2
        exit 1
    fi
    SUFFIX=''
else
    SUFFIX="-$(git rev-parse HEAD | cut -b1-8)"
fi

echo "${RELEASE}${SUFFIX}"

rsp_body:
@echo off

set SCRIPT_DIR=%~dp0
set IS_COPY=%1



SET WINRAR=%SCRIPT_DIR%WINRAR_cn.exe
set NMTOOL_WEB=%SCRIPT_DIR%..
mtool-web

REM 设置临时编译文件夹路径
set build_temp_dir=%SCRIPT_DIR%.. uild_temp_dir

REM 创建编译临时文件夹
if not exist %build_temp_dir% (
	mkdir %build_temp_dir%\r
)

REM 打包前端
ECHO nmtool-web
call "%SCRIPT_DIR%download_tools.bat"
call %SCRIPT_DIR%build_nop_app.bat nmtool %NMTOOL_WEB% %build_temp_dir%

echo errorlevel=%errorlevel%

if not %errorlevel% == 0 (
  echo "build nmtool failed"
  exit 1
)

REM 打包后端
ECHO cum_cm_service
call "%SCRIPT_DIR%clean_build_unm_cm_service.bat"
call %SCRIPT_DIR%build_unm_cm_service.bat
if not %errorlevel% == 0 (
  echo "build nmtool failed,build_unm_cm_service.bat error"
  exit 1
)

IF "%IS_COPY%" == "true" (
 GOTO COPY
) ELSE (
 GOTO END
)
:COPY
call %SCRIPT_DIR%copy_to_unm2000.bat
call %SCRIPT_DIR%make_nmtool_src.bat
GOTO END
:END

REM 删除相关文件
cd %SCRIPT_DIR%..
if EXIST temp.zip (
call del/s/q/f temp.zip
)
IF EXIST build_temp_dir (
	
  call %WINRAR% a -ep1 -r -df temp.zip build_temp_dir
  call del/s/q/f temp.zip
)
call "%SCRIPT_DIR%clean_build_unm_cm_service.bat"
echo success

rsp_body:
#! /bin/sh

writelog () {
	local msg=$1
	logger -i -t "Cusaplatform" $msg
}



# mk link 
# param1: target
# param3: linkname
my_mklink () {
    target_path="$1"
    link_path="$2"
    link_dir=${link_path%/*}

    mkdir -p $link_dir
    chmod 755 $link_dir
    my_rmfile $link_path
    ln -s $target_path $link_path
}

echo install Cusaplatform
writelog "install Cusaplatform"

if test $( pgrep -f Cusaplatform |grep 8088 | wc -l ) -gt 1
then
    echo "ERROR:Cusaplatform is runing, please check and stop it before install!"
    writelog "ERROR:Cusaplatform is runing, please check and stop it before install!"
    exit 0
fi


# set Cusaplatform home directory


cusa_home_dir=$(cd $(dirname $0);cd ..; pwd)
thirdparty_dir=$cusa_home_dir/thirdparty

exec="${cusa_home_dir}/thirdparty/jre/bin/java -Dspring.resources.static-locations=file:${cusa_home_dir}/web -Djava.library.path=${cusa_home_dir}/thirdparty -jar ${cusa_home_dir}/lib/admin-service-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar"
#exec="${cusa_home_dir}/bin/start.sh"
exec_str="ExecStart=${exec}"
line=$(sed -n '/ExecStart/=' $cusa_home_dir/bin/cusaplatform.service)
newline=$(expr $line - 1)
sed -i "$line d" $cusa_home_dir/bin/cusaplatform.service 
sed -i "${newline} a\${exec_str}" $cusa_home_dir/bin/cusaplatform.service



#echo init the cusaadmindb
#mysql --socket ${cusa_home_dir}/thirdparty/mysql_cusa/data/mysql.sock -uroot -pvislecaina <$cusa_home_dir/init/create_table.sql
#mysql --socket ${cusa_home_dir}/thirdparty/mysql_cusa/data/mysql.sock -uroot -pvislecaina <$cusa_home_dir/init/admin-center.sql
#mysql --socket ${cusa_home_dir}/thirdparty/mysql_cusa/data/mysql.sock -uroot -pvislecaina <$cusa_home_dir/init/auto-deploy.sql


echo install Cusaplatform  services





echo start the cusaplatform service
cp ${cusa_home_dir}/bin/cusaplatform.service /usr/lib/systemd/system/cusaplatform.service

chmod 755 /usr/lib/systemd/system/cusaplatform.service
systemctl enable cusaplatform
systemctl start cusaplatform 
echo service cusaplatform start successfully!
writelog "service cusaplatform start successfully!"
exit

#!/bin/bash -x

# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT
# WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied. See the
# License for the specific language governing permissions and limitations
# under the License.

venv=${1:-pep8}
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.132.3.7:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}
export_upper_constratints_file

virtualenv sdist_check && sdist_check/bin/pip install pbr && sdist_check/bin/python setup.py sdist
sdistrc=$?
rm -rf sdist_check

tox -v -e$venv
rc=$?

[ -e .tox/$venv/bin/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
echo "======================================================================"
.tox/${venv}/bin/${freezecmd} freeze
echo "======================================================================"

if [ ! $sdistrc ] ; then
    echo "******************************************************************"
    echo "Project cannot create sdist tarball!!!"
    echo "To reproduce this locally, run: 'python setup.py sdist'"
    echo "******************************************************************"
    exit $sdistrc
fi

exit $rc

rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash -x

# If a bundle file is present, call tox with the jenkins version of
# the test environment so it is used.  Otherwise, use the normal
# (non-bundle) test environment.  Also, run pbr freeze on the
# resulting environment at the end so that we have a record of exactly
# what packages we ended up testing.
#
# Usage: run-tox.sh VENV
#
# Where VENV is the name of the tox environment to run (specified in the
# project's tox.ini file).

venv=$1
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

if [[ -z "$venv" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $?"
    echo
    echo "VENV: The tox environment to run (eg 'python27')"
    exit 1
fi

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.132.3.7:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}

function freeze_venv {
    [ -e $bin_path/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

    echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
    echo "======================================================================"
    ${bin_path}/${freezecmd} freeze | sort -f
    echo "======================================================================"
}

function process_testr_artifacts {
    if [ ! -d ".testrepository" ] ; then
        return
    fi

    if [ -f ".testrepository/0.2" ] ; then
        cp .testrepository/0.2 ./testrepository.subunit
    elif [ -f ".testrepository/0" ] ; then
        $bin_path/testr last --subunit > ./testrepository.subunit
    fi
    #/usr/bin/subunit2html ./testrepository.subunit testr_results.html
    $bin_path/subunit2html ./testrepository.subunit testr_results.html
    SUBUNIT_SIZE=$(du -k ./testrepository.subunit | awk '{print $1}')
    gzip -9 ./testrepository.subunit
    gzip -9 ./testr_results.html

    if [[ "$SUBUNIT_SIZE" -gt 50000 ]]; then
        echo
        echo "testrepository.subunit was > 50 MB of uncompressed data!!!"
        echo "Something is causing tests for this project to log significant amounts"
        echo "of data. This may be writers to python logging, stdout, or stderr."
        echo "Failing this test as a result"
        echo
        exit 1
    fi

    rancount=$($bin_path/testr last | sed -ne 's/Ran \([0-9]\+\).*tests in.*//p')
    if [ -z "$rancount" ] || [ "$rancount" -eq "0" ] ; then
        echo
        echo "Zero tests were run. At least one test should have been run."
        echo "Failing this test as a result"
        echo
        exit 1
    fi
}

function check_sudo_usage {
    sudo $script_path/jenkins-sudo-grep.sh post
    sudoresult=$?

    if [ $sudoresult -ne "0" ]; then
        echo
        echo "This test has failed because it attempted to execute commands"
        echo "with sudo.  See above for the exact commands used."
        echo
        exit 1
    fi
}

function check_oom {
    $script_path/jenkins-oom-grep.sh post
    oomresult=$?

    if [ $oomresult -ne "0" ]; then
        echo
        echo "This test has failed because it attempted to exceed configured"
        echo "memory limits and was killed prior to completion.  See above"
        echo "for related kernel messages."
        echo
        exit 1
    fi
}

function check_nose_html {
    htmlreport=$(find . -name $NOSE_HTML_OUT_FILE)
    if [ -f "$htmlreport" ]; then
        passcount=$(grep -c 'tr class=.passClass' $htmlreport)
        if [ $passcount -eq "0" ]; then
            echo
            echo "Zero tests passed, which probably means there was an error"
            echo "parsing one of the python files, or that some other failure"
            echo "during test setup prevented a sane run."
            echo
            exit 1
        fi
    fi
}


script_path=/usr/local/jenkins/slave_scripts
bin_path=.tox/$venv/bin

export PYTHON=$bin_path/python
export NOSE_WITH_XUNIT=1
export NOSE_WITH_HTML_OUTPUT=1
export NOSE_HTML_OUT_FILE='nose_results.html'
if [[ -z "$TMPDIR" ]]; then
    export TMPDIR=$(/bin/mktemp -d)
fi
trap "rm -rf $TMPDIR" EXIT

export_upper_constratints_file

#cat /etc/image-hostname.txt

#$script_path/jenkins-oom-grep.sh pre

#sudo $script_path/jenkins-sudo-grep.sh pre

tox -v -e$venv
result=$?

freeze_venv
process_testr_artifacts
#check_sudo_usage
#check_oom
check_nose_html

# Rename tox' .log files to .log.txt so that Apache serves them as
# text/plain files since it can handle .txt special - and .log is
# unknown and therefore served as binary.
find .tox -type f -name "*.log" -exec mv {} {}.txt \;

exit $result

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

export PATH=$PATH:/sbin

#
# GB
#
function changeFreeCache()
{
    EXTRA=$1
    MIN=$2
    sysctl -w vm.extra_free_kbytes=${EXTRA}000000
    sysctl -w vm.min_free_kbytes=${MIN}000000
    sysctl -w vm.swappiness=0
}


if [ $# -ne 2 ]
then
    echo "Usage: $0 extra_free_kbytes(GB) min_free_kbytes(GB)"
    echo "Example: $0 3 1"
    exit
fi

changeFreeCache $1 $2

rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

MYSQLDIR=$(cd $(dirname $0); pwd)
MYSQLBIN=$MYSQLDIR/bin/mysql
PASSWORD=vislecaina

echo Working Directory:$MYSQLDIR
echo 
echo *****start working*****

echo 1. create table...
$MYSQLBIN -uroot -p$PASSWORD --socket=$MYSQLDIR/data/mysql.sock -e"use logdb;DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t_logininfo;CREATE TABLE t_logininfo(cseqno bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,  cregisterno int(11),   cserialno int(11),  csessionid int(11),  cdbname varchar(64) ,  clogintime datetime,  cloginname varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,  PRIMARY KEY (cseqno),  KEY ix_logintime (clogintime)) ENGINE = MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8;"

if [ 0 -eq $? ]; then
echo 2. update privilege...
$MYSQLBIN -uroot -p$PASSWORD --socket=$MYSQLDIR/data/mysql.sock  -e"UPDATE mysql.user SET Super_priv = 'N', Insert_priv = 'Y' WHERE USER = 'unm2000';FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"
$MYSQLBIN -uroot -p$PASSWORD --socket=$MYSQLDIR/data/mysql.sock  -e"GRANT all ON logdb.t_logininfo TO unm2000 WITH GRANT OPTION; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"

fi

if [ 0 -eq $? ]; then
echo 3. set login info 
echo "   " >> $MYSQLDIR/my.cnf
echo "init-connect="insert into logdb.t_logininfo ( csessionid, cdbname, clogintime, cloginname) values (connection_id(), database(), now(), user());"" >> $MYSQLDIR/my.cnf
fi

if [ 0 -eq $? ]; then
systemctl stop mysql
systemctl start mysql
fi

if [ 0 -ne $? ]; then
    echo **********************
    echo    working failure!
    echo **********************
    echo check MySQL ROOT PATH: eg:/opt/mysql
    echo 1. check your mysql directory: /opt/mysql/enable_mysql_login_info.sh exists!?
    echo 2. check your mysql file: /opt/mysql/data/mysql.sock  ?
    echo 3. check your mysql password: using default password ?
fi
echo *****end working*****

rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"
