# your version of this file under either the CDDL, the GPL Version 2 or
# to extend the choice of license to its licensees as provided above.
# However, if you add GPL Version 2 code and therefore, elected the GPL
# Version 2 license, then the option applies only if the new code is
# made subject to such option by the copyright holder.
#
# Contributor(s):

#
# resolve symlinks
#

PRG=$0

while [ -h "$PRG" ]; do
    ls=`ls -ld "$PRG"`
    link=`expr "$ls" : '^.*-> \(.*\)$' 2>/dev/null`
    if expr "$link" : '^/' 2> /dev/null >/dev/null; then
	PRG="$link"
    else
	PRG="`dirname "$PRG"`/$link"
    fi
done

progdir=`dirname "$PRG"`
APPNAME=`basename "$PRG"`

if [ -f "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

# XXX does not correctly deal with spaces in non-userdir params
args=""

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        userdir="${default_mac_userdir}"
        ;;
    *)
        userdir="${default_userdir}"
        ;;
esac
while [ $# -gt 0 ] ; do
    case "$1" in
        --userdir) shift; if [ $# -gt 0 ] ; then userdir="$1"; fi
            ;;
        *) args="$args "$1""
            ;;
    esac
    shift
done

if [ -f "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

if [ -n "$jdkhome" -a \! -d "$jdkhome" -a -d "$progdir/../$jdkhome" ]; then
    # #74333: permit jdkhome to be defined as relative to app dir
    jdkhome="$progdir/../$jdkhome"
fi

readClusters() {
  if [ -x /usr/ucb/echo ]; then
    echo=/usr/ucb/echo
  else
    echo=echo
  fi
  while read X; do
    if [ "$X" \!= "" ]; then
      $echo "$progdir/../$X"
    fi
  done
}

absolutize_paths() {
    while read path; do
        if [ -d "$path" ]; then
            (cd "$path" 2>/dev/null && pwd)
        else
            echo "$path"
        fi
    done
}

clusters=`(cat "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".clusters; echo) | readClusters | absolutize_paths | tr '
' ':'`

if [ ! -z "$extra_clusters" ] ; then
    clusters="$clusters:$extra_clusters"
fi

nbexec=`echo "$progdir"/../platform*/lib/nbexec`

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        eval exec sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            -J-Xdock:name='"$APPNAME"' \n            '"-J-Xdock:icon=$progdir/../../$APPNAME.icns"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
        ;;
    *)  
       sh=sh
       # #73162: Ubuntu uses the ancient Bourne shell, which does not implement trap well.
       if [ -x /bin/bash ]
       then
           sh=/bin/bash
       fi
       eval exec $sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
       exit 1
        ;;
esac

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
#!/bin/sh


basePath=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")";pwd)
host_name=$(hostname)
path=${basePath}/${host_name}
arr=`cat ${basePath}/servers.txt`
number=0
VRTSPATH=/opt/VRTS/bin
myhares=$VRTSPATH/hares
myharconf=$VRTSPATH/haconf

function disableclustermonitor(){
for line in ${arr[@]}
do
	array=(${line//,/ })

	if [ ${array[4]} = 0 ]
	then

		#设置需要移除监控的节点为可读写状态
		ssh -i $path ${array[1]}@${array[0]} -o "StrictHostKeyChecking no" "sudo -u ${array[2]} -S ${myharconf} -makerw << EOF
${array[3]}
EOF" &>/dev/null
		echo node ${array[0]} readandwrite,result=$?		
	
		#需要禁用各个节点的sidecar
		echo node ${array[0]}:start disable cluster software monitor of cusasidecar,resourceName=${array[5]}
		ssh -i $path ${array[1]}@${array[0]} -o "StrictHostKeyChecking no" "sudo -u ${array[2]} -S ${myhares} -modify ${array[5]} Critical 0 << EOF
${array[3]}
EOF" &>/dev/null		
#		if [ $? -eq 0 ]
#		then
#			echo node ${array[0]}:finish disable cluster software monitor of ${array[5]},success
#		else
#			echo node ${array[0]}:disable cluster software monitor of ${array[5]},failed,exit
#			exit
#		fi
 

	else
		echo node ${array[0]}:donnot need disable cluster software,skip 
	fi


echo "                    "
	
done



}

sleep 5


function startsidecar(){
for line in ${arr[@]}
do
	array=(${line//,/ })
	echo  node ${array[0]}: begin start sidecar
	ssh -i $path ${array[1]}@${array[0]} -o "StrictHostKeyChecking no" "sudo -u ${array[2]} -S systemctl restart cusasidecar<< EOF
${array[3]}
EOF" &>/dev/null
	echo  node ${array[0]}: finish start sidecar end
	echo "                             "
done


}



#校验各个节点上的sidecar是否都正常启动
function checksidecarstatus(){
for line in ${arr[@]}
do
	array=(${line//,/ })
	echo node ${array[0]}:start check sidecar status
	while : 
	do
		ssh -i $path ${array[1]}@${array[0]} -o "StrictHostKeyChecking no" "sudo -u ${array[2]} -S systemctl status cusasidecar<< EOF
${array[3]}
EOF" &>/dev/null
		if [ $? -eq 0 ]
		then
			echo  node ${array[0]} sidecar is running,next sidecar
			break
		else
			echo node ${array[0]} sidecar donnot start,wait start
			ssh -i $path ${array[1]}@${array[0]} -o "StrictHostKeyChecking no" "sudo -u ${array[2]} -S systemctl restart cusasidecar<< EOF
${array[3]}
EOF" &>/dev/null
			echo node ${array[0]} sidecar donnot start,again start
			sleep 5
		fi
	done
	echo "                             "

done

}

echo =============disable cluster software monitor==============
disableclustermonitor
echo =============start every sidecar==============
startsidecar
echo =============sidecar status==============
checksidecarstatus

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

#current_path=$(dirname $(readlink -f "$0"))
#thirdparty_path=$(dirname $(dirname $current_path))/thirdparty
#定时任务是通过cron.service文件执行的，当前目录变更为根目录了，所以这里采取在安装nginx的时候记录nginx的路径
nginx_home=$(cat /usr/nginx_home)
days=7
LOGS_PATH=$nginx_home/logs
 
NEWLOGS_PATH=$LOGS_PATH/history

if [ ! -d "$NEWLOGS_PATH" ];then
	mkdir $NEWLOGS_PATH
fi
 
YESTERDAY=$(date -d "yesterday" +%Y%m%d)
 

mv ${LOGS_PATH}/access.log ${NEWLOGS_PATH}/access_${YESTERDAY}.log
 
/bin/kill -SIGUSR1 $(cat $nginx_home/nginx.pid)

find $NEWLOGS_PATH/ -mtime +$days -delete

#
# resolve symlinks
#

PRG=$0

while [ -h "$PRG" ]; do
    ls=`ls -ld "$PRG"`
    link=`expr "$ls" : '^.*-> \(.*\)$' 2>/dev/null`
    if expr "$link" : '^/' 2> /dev/null >/dev/null; then
	PRG="$link"
    else
	PRG="`dirname "$PRG"`/$link"
    fi
done

progdir=`dirname "$PRG"`
APPNAME=`basename "$PRG"`
cd "$progdir/../"

if [ -f "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

# XXX does not correctly deal with spaces in non-userdir params
args=""

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        userdir="${default_mac_userdir}"
        ;;
    *)
        userdir="${default_userdir}"
        ;;
esac
while [ $# -gt 0 ] ; do
    case "$1" in
        --userdir) shift; if [ $# -gt 0 ] ; then userdir="$1"; fi
            ;;
        *) args="$args "$1""
            ;;
    esac
    shift
done

if [ -f "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

if [ -n "$jdkhome" -a \! -d "$jdkhome" -a -d "$progdir/../$jdkhome" ]; then
    # #74333: permit jdkhome to be defined as relative to app dir
    jdkhome="$progdir/../$jdkhome"
fi

readClusters() {
  if [ -x /usr/ucb/echo ]; then
    echo=/usr/ucb/echo
  else
    echo=echo
  fi
  while read X; do
    if [ "$X" \!= "" ]; then
      $echo "$progdir/../$X"
    fi
  done
}

absolutize_paths() {
    while read path; do
        if [ -d "$path" ]; then
            (cd "$path" 2>/dev/null && pwd)
        else
            echo "$path"
        fi
    done
}

clusters=`(cat "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".clusters; echo) | readClusters | absolutize_paths | tr '
' ':'`

if [ ! -z "$extra_clusters" ] ; then
    clusters="$clusters:$extra_clusters"
fi

nbexec=`echo "$progdir"/../platform*/lib/nbexec`

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        eval exec sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            -J-Xdock:name='"$APPNAME"' \n            '"-J-Xdock:icon=$progdir/../../$APPNAME.icns"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
        ;;
    *)  
       sh=sh
       # #73162: Ubuntu uses the ancient Bourne shell, which does not implement trap well.
       if [ -x /bin/bash ]
       then
           sh=/bin/bash
       fi
       eval exec $sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"

#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_DIR=$(dirname $(readlink -f "$0"))
IS_COPY=$1

#加载python环境,持续集成已经设置python环境,不需要再进行设置
#source $UNM_ROOT/server/tool/unmvars.sh

cd $SCRIPT_DIR

#编译前端代码
echo -------build frontend app begin----------
python build_nmtool_web/build_nmtool_web.py
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
	echo "build nmtool_web failed"
	exit -1
else
	echo "build nmtool_web success"
fi
echo -------build frontend app end------------

#编译后端代码
chmod 777 build_unm_cm_service.sh
sh build_unm_cm_service.sh
exit_status_cm=$?
echo $exit_status_cm
if [ $exit_status_cm -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "build_unm_cm_service failed"
  exit -1
fi

#拷贝到网管环境
if [ $IS_COPY == "true" ];
then
	chmod 777 copy_to_unm2000.sh
	sh copy_to_unm2000.sh
	chmod 777 make_nmtool_src.sh
	sh make_nmtool_src.sh
fi

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
#! /bin/bash

main(){
systemctl stop firewalld
systemctl disable firewalld
curl=`curl --version 2> /dev/null`
wget=`wget --version 2> /dev/null`
if [ "${curl#*"curl"}" != "$curl" ]; then
       downloader="curl"
elif [ "${wget#*"Wget"}" != "$wget" ]; then
       downloader="wget"
else
       echo "Please instll curl or wget"
       exit 1
fi

vscp_dir="/usr/local/vscp"
if [ ! -f "$vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh" ];then
       sh $vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh
fi
sleep  1
if [ ! -d "$vscp_dir" ];then
       mkdir $vscp_dir
fi

if [ "$downloader"=="curl" ];then
	 curl -o $vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client http://10.190.160.90:30001/api/v1/vm/deploy/k8s-vm-client
else
	 wget -O $vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client http://10.190.160.90:30001/api/v1/vm/deploy/k8s-vm-client
fi

echo -e "#?/bin/bash
$vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client 10.190.160.90:8848 > $vscp_dir/run.log &" > $vscp_dir/vscp_start.sh

echo -e "#?/bin/bash
systemctl stop vscp
rm -f /usr/lib/systemd/system/vscp.service
rm -f /lib/systemd/system/vscp.service
rm -rf /usr/local/vscp
systemctl daemon-reload" > $vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh

echo -e "[Unit]
Description=vscp client
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=forking
ExecStart=/bin/bash -c $vscp_dir/vscp_start.sh
ExecReload=
ExecStop=/bin/bash -c  ps -ef|grep k8s-vm-client |grep -v grep |awk '{print \$2}'

PrivateTmp=True

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target" > /lib/systemd/system/vscp.service

chmod -R 777 $vscp_dir

systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable vscp
systemctl start vscp

}

#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

rsp_body:
@echo off

::先停止服务
taskkill /f /im nginx.exe
taskkill /f /im javaw.exe

cd /d %~dp0
cd ..
set WEB_HOME=%cd%

set SERVICE_HOME=%WEB_HOME%\service\cable-health-monitor

::启动nginx
set NGINX_HOME=%WEB_HOME%	hirdparty
ginx
cd %NGINX_HOME%
start nginx.exe

set JAVA_HOME=%WEB_HOME%	hirdparty\java
::设置jvm参数
set DEBUG_ARG=-Xdebug -Xnoagent -Djava.compiler=NONE -Xrunjdwp:transport=dt_socket,server=y,suspend=n,address=5005
set JMX_ARG=-Djava.rmi.server.hostname=localhost -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.port=8087 -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.rmi.port=8087 -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticate=false -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.ssl=false  -Xmx2g -Xms2g -Xmn1g
set DUMP_ARG=-XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError -XX:HeapDumpPath=%SERVICE_HOME%icloud_%t.hprof

start %JAVA_HOME% in\javaw %DEBUG_ARG% %JMX_ARG% %DUMP_ARG% -jar -Dspring.profiles.active=prod %SERVICE_HOME%\cable-health-monitor-starter.jar &
exit

#!/bin/bash
source /etc/profile
cp -f $UNM_ROOT/tools/scripts/*.server /etc/init.d/
ln -s $UNM_ROOT/tools/nginx  /usr/local/nginx

result=$( cat /etc/SuSE-release | grep "VERSION = 12" )
if [[ "$result" != "" ]] ;then
     version="12"
else
     version="11"
fi
echo $version
if [[ "$version" = "12" ]] ;then
  if [[ $dbtype =~ "1" ]] ;then
    cp -f $UNM_ROOT/tools/scripts/unm2000service/unm2000.service.mysql /usr/lib/systemd/system/unm2000.service
    chmod 777 /usr/lib/systemd/system/unm2000.service
  elif [[ $dbtype =~ "4" ]] ;then
    cp -f $UNM_ROOT/tools/scripts/unm2000service/unm2000.service.oracle /usr/lib/systemd/system/unm2000.service
    chmod 777 /usr/lib/systemd/system/unm2000.service
  fi
   # cp -f $UNM_ROOT/tools/scripts/unm2000service/unmtool.service /usr/lib/systemd/system/unmtool.service
   # chmod 777 /usr/lib/systemd/system/unmtool.service
fi

#²é¿´ÏµÍ³°æ±¾
syspath=$(uname -a)
#Èç¹ûÏµÍ³°æ±¾Îªaarch64Ôò°²×°libatomic-7.3.0-20190804.35.p02.ky10.aarch64.rpm
if [[ ${syspath} =~ "aarch64" ]];then
	rpm -ivh "${UNM_ROOT}/platform/bin/libatomic-7.3.0-20190804.35.p02.ky10.aarch64.rpm"
fi

#chmod -R 777 /etc/init.d/unmtomcat.server
chmod -R 777 /etc/init.d/unm.server
chmod -R 777 /etc/init.d/unmstart.server
chmod -R 777 /etc/init.d/unmstop.server
# chmod -R 777 /etc/init.d/unmtool.server
# chmod -R 777 /etc/init.d/unmtoolstart.server
# chmod -R 777 /etc/init.d/unmtoolstop.server
# chmod 777 /etc/init.d/unmactivemq.server
# chmod 777 /etc/init.d/unmtao.server
cd /etc/init.d

# Éú³ÉÁÙÊ±license
chmod 777 $UNM_ROOT/platform/bin/unm_license_tryout
$UNM_ROOT/platform/bin/unm_license_tryout --Name unm2000 --Password unm2K10 --UNMRoot $UNM_ROOT
# Éú³ÉÁÙÊ±licenseºóÉ¾³ýlicenseÉú³É¹¤¾ß
if [[ -f "$UNM_ROOT/platform/bin/unm_license_tryout" ]];then
	rm -f "$UNM_ROOT/platform/bin/unm_license_tryout"
fi


if [[ "$version" = "12" ]] ;then
systemctl enable unm2000.service
# systemctl enable unmtool.service
else
#chkconfig --add unmtomcat.server
chkconfig --add unmstart.server
# chkconfig --add unmtoolstart.server
fi


#cusa°æ±¾£¬linux°æ±¾Íø¹Ü¹ÜÀí¹¤¾ß·þÎñÆô¶¯
revisionfile=$UNM_ROOT/server/etc/revision.txt
grep "iscusa=true" $revisionfile>>/dev/nul
if [ $? -eq 0 ];then
	if [[ $deploymode -eq 1 || $deploymode -eq 2 ]];then
		sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/configedit/cusamonitorservice/install_cusamonitor_service.sh
	fi
	sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/sidecar/bin/install_sidecar_service.sh
fi

if [[ $deploymode -eq 1 || $deploymode -eq 2 ]];then
	sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/scripts/install_nmtool.sh
else
	sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/install_nmtool_agent.sh
	sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/set_nmtool_var.sh
fi

# ×¢²ánginx²¢Æô¶¯
sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nginx/script_linux/install_unm_web.sh
sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nginx/script_linux/start_service.sh

#×¢²áË«Òò×Ó·þÎñ
sh $UNM_ROOT/platform/jar/authserver/bin/install_authserver.sh

# export CATALINA_BASE=$UNM_ROOT/jetty
# cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/scripts/tomcatserver/*.* $CATALINA_BASE

# cd $CATALINA_BASE

# chmod -R 777 $CATALINA_BASE/install.sh
# chmod -R 777 $CATALINA_BASE/setenv.sh
# chmod -R 777 $CATALINA_BASE/tomcat.service
# chmod -R 777 $CATALINA_BASE/uninstalltomcat.sh
chmod -R 777 $UNM_ROOT/jetty/install.sh
sh $UNM_ROOT/jetty/install.sh
#¿ª»ú×ÔÆô¶¯ TAO
chkconfig unmactivemq.server on
chkconfig unmtao.server on

rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash -xe
# The script is jenkins job to compile rpm packages for fitos.
# Jenkins Parameters:
# $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH: the branch for repository manifest
# $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE: incremental compile or not
# $PKG_LIST: package targets list to compile, empty to compile all
# $FH_DATE: compile time formated yyyyMMdd_HHmm
# Such as: http://10.132.3.10:8080/view/FitOS-CD/job/fitos-compile-rpm/
# The script must be executed at compile machine, such as 10.127.2.26

source /usr/local/bin/finishSetup.sh
openEuler_RPM_code=()

openEuler_RPM_spec=()

tis_patch_ver=`date +"%y%m%d"`
_tis_dist=.fitos.v5r2m3


if [ ! $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE ]; then
  INCREMENTAL_COMPILE=false
fi

if [[ $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE == false ]]; then
  # clean dir
  sudo rm -rf $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
  sudo rm -rf $MY_WORKSPACE
  mkdir -p $MY_REPO
  mkdir -p $MY_WORKSPACE

  # init repo manifest
  cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
  repo init -u ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/manifest.git -b $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH -m default.xml --repo-url=ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/git-repo.git --no-repo-verify
fi

cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
repo sync

#Insert CPU_ARCH to all spec files
if [ ! $CPU_ARCH ];then
	CPU_ARCH=x86_64
fi
find ./ -name '*.spec' | xargs sed -i '1 i\%define arch '"$CPU_ARCH"''

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        sed -i 's/%{?_tis_dist}/'"$_tis_dist"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
        sed -i 's/%{tis_patch_ver}/'"$tis_patch_ver"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

###Clean up rpmbuild/
##ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SRPMS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILD/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILDROOT/*
##exit
##eeooff
##
###Copy openEuler source code and spec files to 10.127.2.239
##cd $MY_REPO/stx/git
##for i in ${openEuler_RPM_code[@]}
##    do
##        tar -zcf $i.tar.gz $i
##        scp $i.tar.gz fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/
##        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/git/$i.tar.gz
##    done
##
##for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
##    do
##        scp $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
##        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
##    done

#build Centos RPMs
cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
build-pkgs $PKG_LIST
rm -rf ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.src.rpm

###build openEuler RPMs
##ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
##set -o errexit
##cd /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
##rpmbuild -ba *
##set +o errexit
##exit
##eeooff
##if [[ $? -ne 0 ]];then
##    exit 1
##fi
##
### Copy RPMs to 10.132.3.4
##if [ ! $FH_DATE ]; then
##  FH_DATE=`date +%Y%m%d_%H%M`
##fi

if [ $CPU_ARCH == x86_64 ];then
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ## scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
else
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  sleep 5
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ## scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
fi

@echo off

set current_path=%~dp0
cd %current_path%

set YEAR=%date:~0,4%

	set ThisTime=0%time:~1,1%%time:~3,2%
) else (
	set ThisTime=%time:~0,2%%time:~3,2%
)


::-----download dev_tools------------------

net use * /del /y
net use \10.170.1.27 "Unm2000any@@" /user:zhaozhi

if exist %server_path% (
	rd /q /s %server_path%

)
if not exist %server_path%\windows md %server_path%\windows

if not exist %server_path%rm md %server_path%rm

if exist %server_path%\CusaAllInOne.exe del /f /q %server_path%\CusaAllInOne.exe>nul

copy /y %WORKSPACE%\CusaAllInOne\package\CusaAllInOne_linux_arm.zip %server_path%rm
copy /y %WORKSPACE%\CusaAllInOne\package\CusaInstall.zip %server_path%\windows
copy /y %WORKSPACE%\CusaAllInOne\windows\CusaDeployAgent_win.zip %server_path%\windows

copy /y %WORKSPACE%\CusaAllInOne\package\CusaDeployAgent_linux_arm.zip %server_path%rm
if exist %WORKSPACE%\svn_url.txt copy /y %WORKSPACE%\svn_url.txt %server_path%
if exist %WORKSPACE%\git_url.txt copy /y %WORKSPACE%\git_url.txt %server_path%

:end

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
#! /bin/bash

main(){
curl=`curl --version 2> /dev/null`
wget=`wget --version 2> /dev/null`
if [ "${curl#*"curl"}" != "$curl" ]; then
       downloader="curl"
elif [ "${wget#*"Wget"}" != "$wget" ]; then
       downloader="wget"
else
       echo "Please instll curl or wget"
       exit 1
fi

vscp_dir="/usr/local/vscp"
if [ ! -f "$vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh" ];then
       sh $vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh
fi
sleep  1
if [ ! -d "$vscp_dir" ];then
       mkdir $vscp_dir
fi

if [ "$downloader"=="curl" ];then
	 curl -o $vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client http://10.190.160.90:30001/api/v1/vm/deploy/k8s-vm-client
else
	 wget -O $vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client http://10.190.160.90:30001/api/v1/vm/deploy/k8s-vm-client
fi

echo -e "#?/bin/bash
$vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client 10.190.160.90:8848 > $vscp_dir/run.log &" > $vscp_dir/vscp_start.sh

echo -e "#?/bin/bash
systemctl stop vscp
rm -f /usr/lib/systemd/system/vscp.service
rm -f /lib/systemd/system/vscp.service
rm -rf /usr/local/vscp
systemctl daemon-reload" > $vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh

echo -e "[Unit]
Description=vscp client
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=forking
ExecStart=/bin/bash -c $vscp_dir/vscp_start.sh
ExecReload=
ExecStop=/bin/bash -c  ps -ef|grep k8s-vm-client |grep -v grep |awk '{print \$2}'

PrivateTmp=True

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target" > /lib/systemd/system/vscp.service

chmod -R 777 $vscp_dir

iptables -t nat -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 8000 -j ACCEPT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable vscp
systemctl start vscp

}

rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
rsp_body:
@echo off

set SCRIPT_DIR=%~dp0
set IS_COPY=%1



cd %SCRIPT_DIR%
echo %cd%
@REM 编译前端代码
echo -------build frontend app begin----------
python build_nmtool_web/build_nmtool_web.py

if not %errorlevel% == 0 (
  echo "build nmtool_web failed"
  exit 1
)
echo -------build frontend app end------------

REM 打包后端
ECHO cum_cm_service
call "%SCRIPT_DIR%clean_build_unm_cm_service.bat"
call %SCRIPT_DIR%build_unm_cm_service.bat
if not %errorlevel% == 0 (
  echo "build nmtool failed,build_unm_cm_service.bat error"
  exit 1
)

IF "%IS_COPY%" == "true" (
 GOTO COPY
) ELSE (
 GOTO END
)
:COPY
call %SCRIPT_DIR%copy_to_unm2000.bat
call %SCRIPT_DIR%make_nmtool_src.bat
GOTO END
:END

REM 删除相关文件
cd %SCRIPT_DIR%..
if EXIST temp.zip (
call del/s/q/f temp.zip
)
IF EXIST build_temp_dir (
	
  call %WINRAR% a -ep1 -r -df temp.zip build_temp_dir
  call del/s/q/f temp.zip
)
call "%SCRIPT_DIR%clean_build_unm_cm_service.bat"
echo success
